fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-06-29 at roughly 15:20, it was reported that goods ordered from a website for Rs. 96,000 were not delivered, and the seller could not be reached. Vidhya Ammal submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000144. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100011 as the destination of the transfer. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Sathish Sundaram, using the number 9000000372. The complainant mentioned digital documents and social media screenshots. The account SYN-ACC-100011 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00110, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, screenshot, suspect, receiving account, digital document, afternoon, mobile number
